All inputs are caller-attested and may be incomplete; the reconciler performs no chain reads, no signature recovery and no digest recomputation, and only the token contract enforces nonce uniqueness on chain. ERC-3009 is a Draft. The classification is not a conformance verdict about any token implementation, not an authorization to move funds and not proof that funds moved.
